prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-10-22, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-10-22):
| Current ratio           | 1.07 |
| Retained earnings       | 167,281M |
| Current liabilities     | 50,869M |
| Current assets          | 54,611M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 79,277M |
| Total liabilities       | 113,539M |
| Total assets            | 192,816M |
| EBIT / operating income | 7,096M |
| Revenue                 | 23,993M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company shows solid profitability with an EBIT margin near 7,096/23,993 ≈ 29.6% and a debt load of total liabilities to assets around 0.59 (debt to equity ≈ 1.43). Liquidity is modest (current ratio 1.07) with limited cushion to cover short-term obligations, and lack of interest expense data prevents a full coverage assessment. Overall, credit risk appears moderate with decent earnings support but leverage and thin liquidity warrant a mid-grade investment rating.

DECISION: BBB
